   cp Quarter1_Reports/*.txt Archived_Quarter1/
   ```

```bash
mkdir -p Archived_Quarter1
find Quarter1_Reports -type f -name "*.txt" -exec cp {} Archived_Quarter1/ \;
```

這樣就能把 `Quarter1_Reports` 目錄中的所有文字檔複製到 `Archived_Quarter1` 目錄中。
